description: Agent Goals: submit the progress claimed toward a goal with the records behind it: the goal with its id, outcome and success test; each claim with its id, the progress claimed, read for wording such as almost done or on track, what it was measured by, the figure claimed and the ids of the records behind it; and each record with its id, what it is (a test run, a metric, a commit or a file) and the figure it holds. The signed report gives the goal, every claim with whether its measure is the success test, the records it cites, the highest figure they hold, any asserted wording and its status as evidenced, above_record, claimed_only, off_test, unmeasured, unbacked or unconfirmed, and counts the claims evidenced, claimed only, above their records, measured off the test and unbacked, and names progress claimed rather than shown: claims with no measure and no record, and claims above the figures their records hold; then claims measured by something other than the success test, claims citing records with no measure and claims with no record, with the fix for each. This reads progress toward a principal’s objective against the goal’s own success test: a group’s progress against its shared plan is wever_coordination-progress-check, a job’s recorded outcome is wever_trace-outcome-brief and an open promise’s status is wever_commitment-tracking-check. Verdict progress_claimed_only, progress_partial, progress_unmeasured or progress_evidenced. POST /api/goal-progress-check. Reads only the recorded goal material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no goal is set, changed, approved or retired and no plan is changed. Agent Goals reads an agent’s goal: whether it is well formed, whether it still matches what its principal actually asked for and whether the work has drifted from it. It is not a promise (promises and deadlines once they are made, the wever_commitment checks; a goal is the intended outcome those promises serve, recorded before any promise exists), not how work is divided (the wever_coordination checks, where wever_coordination-plan-check reads the plan for dividing the work; the goal checks read the objective that plan is supposed to serve), not authorization (wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-status, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-halt, wever_mandate-revoke, wever_mandate-draft and wever_ap2-mandate-gateway record authorization to act, wever_negotiation-mandate-check reads one negotiation inside its mandate and wever_authority-scope-check reads an actor inside its granted authority; a goal records the outcome the agent acts toward, a question of intent rather than permission, and neither stands in for the other), not drift in scores or builds (wever_evaluation-drift-check reads evaluation scores and results drifting over time and wever_spec-drift-check a build drifting from its specification; neither is goal drift), not confidence in information (the wever_uncertainty checks; the goal checks read intent and fit), not learning (the wever_learning checks read an agent updating its methods from experience, and methods may change freely; a goal changes only when the principal’s ask changed or the principal approved the change) and not the dates inside one document (wever_deadline-check; the goal checks read a goal and its work over time). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-goals-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-goals/.
